title: How One Line Blacked Out San Diego
description:
How did one tripped line cascade into a blackout for nearly seven million people?

Sources:
- U.S. Department of Energy — Grid: https://www.energy.gov/gdo/grid-deployment-office
- NERC reliability: https://www.nerc.com/

Technical illustrations and dependency models are labelled. Estimates and industry claims are attributed; modeled consequences are not presented as observed fact.

Critical Thread · Episode 6 · One hidden system the modern world depends on, every day.
